---
title: "Teaching"
subtitle: "Statistics, data analysis and experimental methods"
---

I teach statistics and data analysis at **Universidad de San Andrés**, and give
graduate courses and workshops on statistical inference with R at various
institutions. Nearly all of the material is open: the repositories with
tutorials, problem sets and data are linked from each course.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Course material
If you are looking for the material of a course you are currently taking, the
repositories below hold the tutorials, problem sets and data.
:::

## Universidad de San Andrés

::: {.entry}
### CC408 — Data Science
BA in Behavioural Sciences. Introduction to data analysis with R: data wrangling
and visualisation with the tidyverse, reproducible workflows, and communicating
results.

[Tutorials and problem sets](https://github.com/spiousas/CC408_2024){.entry-meta}
:::

::: {.entry}
### CC400 — Problem sets
Problem sets and supporting material for the course.

[Problem set repository](https://github.com/spiousas/practicos_CC400){.entry-meta}
:::

::: {.entry}
### MCC302
Course in the MSc in Behavioural Sciences.

[Course material](https://github.com/spiousas/MCC302){.entry-meta}
:::

::: {.entry}
### Experimental design
Design of experiments in the behavioural sciences: control of variables, sample
size, and analysis matched to the design.

[Course material](https://github.com/spiousas/ExpDes){.entry-meta}
:::

## Graduate courses and workshops

::: {.entry}
### Statistical inference for periodic data in neuroscience
Universidad de la República, Uruguay · 2025

Graduate course on inference applied to time series and periodic data: rhythms,
periodicity, and their statistical pitfalls.

[Course repository](https://github.com/spiousas/Inferencia_UdelaR_2025){.entry-meta}
:::

::: {.entry}
### Statistical inference (pre-SAN course)
Argentine Society for Neuroscience Research · 2024

Satellite course on statistical inference for early-career researchers.

[Course repository](https://github.com/spiousas/InferenciaSAN2024){.entry-meta}
:::

::: {.entry}
### Inference with R
Universidad Nacional de Quilmes · 2021 and 2022

Introduction to statistical inference using R, with an emphasis on simulation
and on interpreting results.

[2022 edition](https://github.com/spiousas/Inferencia_con_R_UNQ2022) ·
[2021 edition](https://github.com/spiousas/Inferencia_con_R_UNQ2021){.entry-meta}
:::

## Outreach and community

- **[Contar con datos](https://github.com/spiousas/data_Udezzza_contar_con_datos)** —
